_: T319 store shots, SET 4 (owner 2026-11-19: ~00:15 "We lost the split screen shots", ~00:17 "Couldn't we combine more together?", ~00:19 "The first ones should include one about conditions"). The same 7 for Play and the App Store. Each `scene` is a play-shots.mjs scene from the web app; every capture is the web app (owner 2026-11-19 ~01:03 "can all images be generated with the webapp?": the Spots and Help scenes need a web export built with EXPO_PUBLIC_STORE_SHOTS=1); the rivers split opens the day's river (store-shots/pick-river.mjs); `compose` stacks real captures under dark caption bars (crops from..to of each part's height, per raw size in `at`, plus the bands, sum to 1). `only` (target names) keeps a shot to those sets. Titles: plain words, about 6 at most, no "we". The optional 8th (the forecast map by day, 13-cond-forecast) is out: its scene does not find the day buttons on the current UI; recheck on 0.8.2.
